'''Torim''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. A light skinned Human [[Gender/Legends|female]] with black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and [[brown]] eyes, she was one of many of his [[Species/Legends|species]] who settled on Taris. A fluent speaker of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], Torim wore light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for protection from the world's wildlife. She sold light [[Armor/Legends|armor]] from her shop in [[Olaris]], the headquarters of the Republic-sponsored [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Torim appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a Light Armor Vendor for Republic players on Taris.<ref name="TOR" /> With the release of Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]],<ref name="4.0">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/10202015/game-update-4.0-knights-fallen-empire-early-access|text=Game Update 4.0: Knights of the Fallen Empire Early Access Patch Notes}}</ref> Torim was removed from the game along with the rest of the Light Armor Vendors.<ref name="TOR" />
